games.title: Claude Bomb
games.pitch: Claude knows how to defuse it. Only you can see it.
games.about: Night shift at Meridian Labs. A device in Bay 3, a manual you cannot read, and Claude on the radio. Describe what you see, share the right pages, and defuse all five modules before the clock runs out.
games.device: A computer, or a tablet held sideways

games.title: AI Arena
games.pitch: Build an agent. Press run. Lose control.
games.about: Every student writes the instructions, the memory and the senses of one agent. Then the agents play on their own, and a vague instruction gets an agent eliminated in front of the class.
games.device: A computer, or a tablet held sideways

games.title: Robot Racing
games.topic: How a machine learns from reward
games.pitch: You set the points. It teaches itself to race.
games.about: Every student gets the same robot, and nobody drives it. You decide what it senses, what it may do and what earns points. Then watch it crash for a hundred attempts, slowly get good, and find out what it learns when you reward slightly the wrong thing.
games.players: Solo or a class, one machine
games.device: A computer, or a tablet held sideways

games.title: Tech Escape
games.pitch: Fix what is misconfigured. Then the facility runs the attack.
games.about: A permit office in lockdown. Every room is a system that is genuinely misconfigured, and you have to fix it; then the facility runs the attack against whatever you built and shows you what got through. The exit stays locked until you can reconstruct the whole chain.
games.players: Solo or a class, one machine
games.device: A computer, or a tablet held sideways
